Crisp Yorkshire puddings

Tall, crisp puddings for a Sunday roast. The secret is a very hot tin.

Ingredients

  • 140g plain flour
  • 4 medium eggs
  • 200ml semi-skimmed milk
  • 2 tbsp sunflower oil plus extra for the tin
  • gravy to serve (optional)
  • a pinch of salt

Method

  • step 1

    Heat the oven to 230C/210C fan/gas 8. Pour a little oil into each hole of a 12-hole muffin tin and heat it in the oven.

  • step 2

    Whisk the flour, eggs, milk, oil and salt into a smooth batter.

  • step 3

    Pour the batter into the hot tin, filling each hole halfway.

  • step 4

    Bake for 20 mins without opening the oven door, until risen and deep golden.
